summary: Lincoln County, MT: Kootenai NF lookout built 1924 near Fortine, moved to Eureka city park in 1979, now at Tobacco Valley Historical Village; FFLA lists the original site as gone.

facts.design: 40' steel tower with 6x6' wooden cab; permanent cabin quarters added in the 1940s
facts.status_note: FFLA lists the original site as Tower Gone; the tower now stands at the Tobacco Valley Historical Village in Eureka

access.note: At the Tobacco Valley Historical Village: grounds open year-round; buildings open Memorial Day to Labor Day, 1 to 5 pm. Sources read do not say whether the tower can be climbed.

corrections.why: The current note is garbled and gives no move date; firelookout.com dates the move to the Eureka city park in 1979, and the 2024 newsletter places the lookout at the village

notes_for_editor: The 1920 crow's nest, 1924 build and 1979 move rest on one history page (firelookout.com); the 2024 newsletter and FFLA list corroborate the current location. No staffing, fire or rental information found, so none is in the story. The village's fire-tower mention does not name the lookout, so the story links the two through the newsletter and FFLA list. The waymarking page for the village tower returned only its title and was not used. Brief record's 'None relocated' event note is garbled (see corrections).
